title: Stay-operations fulfillment layer absent (check-in/out, room assignment, housekeeping, turnover buffer, damage claims)
expected: Guest/merchant check-in/out with audit, room assignment, housekeeping status, overstay conflict handling
actual: FSM has only CONFIRMED->COMPLETED; no ops endpoints/tables at all
root_cause: Feature never built (supplierwebhook COMPLETED flip is the only completion path)

title: Caution-deposit feature absent (no liability tracking, deduction, or separate refund)
file_paths: stays_reservation.payment_method DEPOSIT unused; no stays_deposit table
expected: Refundable deposit held as liability, adjudicated deduction, separate release from stay earnings
actual: No deposit entity/rail exists; DEPOSIT enum value is dead

title: Notifier/Auditor sinks unwired in RegisterStays (auditSafe/notifySafe no-op in production)
expected: Booking/cancel/refund events audit-persisted and notifications emitted to guest+hotelier
actual: Deps literal leaves Notifier and Auditor nil — interfaces exist but nothing injected
root_cause: Interface seams added but orchestrator wiring never completed
fix_status: recorded — wiring fix is small (shared finance_routes call site)

title: No-show forfeits full gross regardless of booked policy (not policy-differentiated)
expected: Policy-specific no-show penalty (e.g. first-night) per booked plan
actual: MarkNoShow keeps 100% of gross on every plan — generic full charge
root_cause: Deliberate design comment "no-show earns the stay" — needs product decision per workbook

title: Card/transfer payment rails absent in stays checkout (wallet-escrow only)
expected: Card capture and bank-transfer reconciliation per workbook; under/overpayment handling
actual: PaymentMethod enum accepts CARD/TRANSFER/DEPOSIT but Book escrows the wallet regardless
root_cause: Stays rides the platform wallet; gateway checkout never wired into the stays saga
fix_status: recorded — gateway funding is platform paystack/wallet rail

title: Merchant dispute-response route absent (host cannot answer a dispute)
expected: Merchant submits response/evidence within deadline on own dispute
actual: Generic disputes have reporter rows only; no merchant-side response/queue route
root_cause: Shared disputes module has no counterparty response entity

title: Commission/fee schedule not admin-configurable (single 15% constant) and no per-type rates
expected: Distinct configurable commission for hotel vs shortlet with effective-dated schedule
actual: One compile-time 15% bps for all Direct bookings; no config entity

title: Admin dispute-resolve route gated by restaurant.admin.disputes for ALL module types
expected: Stays dispute resolution gated by a stays/finance permission
actual: Any stays dispute resolve requires the food-domain permission slug
root_cause: Route guard predates multi-module disputes; single shared gate

title: Generic dispute Open validates no reference ownership (any user can dispute any ref)
actual: Open accepts arbitrary module_type+reference with no ownership check (resolver now refuses mismatched reporter at resolve time)
root_cause: Generic Open never validated references per module

title: Prebook/unpaid reservations never expire (no hold-TTL sweeper; PAYMENT_HELD/BOOKING wedges rely on manual reconciliation)
file_paths: reservation states PREBOOK_OK/PAYMENT_HELD/BOOKING; admin dashboard paid_unconfirmed metric only
expected: Unpaid order expires releasing hold; crash-safe rerun of hold-expiry jobs
actual: No sweeper; stuck sagas surface only on admin dashboard counters
root_cause: No scheduled expiry job exists for stays

title: Request-to-book / host-approval booking model absent (instant book only)
expected: Host approves/declines a pending request before charge
actual: No pending-approval state or host decision surface
root_cause: Product model is instant-book only; conditional scope unresolved

title: Receipt is a voucher ref, not a formal invoice; no tax/legal invoice document
expected: Unique downloadable invoice with legal/tax/counterparty fields
actual: voucher_ref + presigned URL only; no invoice generator
